versions.content: If FlexRay NM is in Ready Sleep state, the configuration parameter FRNM_CYCLE_COUNTER_EMULATION is set to TRUE and the FlexRay Global Time could not be retrieved, every time the emulated repetition cycle end is reached, the FlexRay NM shall count this as one NM Repetition Cycle without any positive vote. If FlexRay NM counted FrNmReadySleepCnt plus one NM Repetition Cycles without any positive NM-Vote the FlexRay NM shall perform a transition to Bus Sleep state.
